integrity: Unrestricted proof by logarithmic differentiation, prime-denominator obstructions, and exact finite support classification. Finite tests are supplementary, and independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only even \(n=2^a p^b\) with odd prime \(p\) and at most two distinct odd prime factors of \(p-1\) are classified; safe-prime infinitude is not asserted.
title: Even two-prime solutions of the arithmetic derivative of Euler’s totient
